name: Bloodmage: Barely Human raises armor penetration and health-cost spell damage (#1918)
contract: Barely Human 504254 (15%) and 504894 (30%): "Increases your armor penetration and the damage of spells that cost health by $s2%." Effect 0 is aura 280 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT with MiscValue 0 and an empty class mask, the shape Unit::CalcArmorReducedDamage accepts unconditionally at Unit.cpp:2298, so it applies to every attack. Effect 1 is aura 108 with MiscValue 0 = SPELLMOD_DAMAGE and Effect 2 the same aura with MiscValue 22 = SPELLMOD_DOT, both over the Bloodmage health-cost set; enumerating either mask over SpellFamilyName 26 in Spell.dbc selects Bloodmoon Blast 500125 among 66 other family members. Both the direct and the periodic modifier are asserted, because a partial implementation that only wired SPELLMOD_DAMAGE would pass the first and fail the second. Aura 108 is consumed by AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:173). No source or SQL change is involved.
